a, b, n = map(int, input().split())

def compute_abs(val):
    return -val if val < 0 else val

min_diff = 1e100
answer_x = 0
answer_y = 0

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    x = i
    y1 = int((a / b) * i)
    y2 = y1 + 1
    diff1 = compute_abs((a / b) - (y1 / x))
    diff2 = compute_abs((a / b) - (y2 / x))
    if min_diff > diff1:
        min_diff = diff1
        answer_x = y1
        answer_y = x
    if min_diff > diff2:
        min_diff = diff2
        answer_x = y2
        answer_y = x

print(f"{answer_x}/{answer_y}")
